UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_dups', d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no))::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return_dups', d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id)::VARCHAR, '', ''
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY d.fiscal_year

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, m.net_sales, c.ctrl_sales, m.net_sales - c.ctrl_sales AS diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctrl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.net_sales IS NULL OR c.ctrl_sales IS NULL OR abs(m.net_sales - c.ctrl_sales) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wk AS (

),
grid AS (SELECT s.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900) s CROSS JOIN wk w),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(f.net_amount) net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)

FROM grid g LEFT JOIN sales s USING (store_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
WHERE s.net_sales IS NULL OR s.days < 6 OR s.net_sales <= 0

WITH store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period = 4) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-08-03' - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS n_stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.n_stores AS stores_ty, ly.n_stores AS stores_ly
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
